text:
Carla: Heads up — targeting 2026-04-02 22:00 UTC for the deploy (canary -> prod). I need a rollback owner + smoke owners. Runbook: <https://redwood/ops/runbooks/deploy-rollback> :eyes:

Brian: I can own the user-facing smoke checks (auth flows + chat generation). Ping @Sam for runtime perf checks.

Elise: I'll be the rollback owner. Runbook updated this morning. Short rollback playbook: 1) pin model-router to previous image tag, 2) scale replicas back to pre-rollout count, 3) invalidate prefix/KV caches. I can execute if we hit criteria.

Sam: On standby for cache/KV and latency digging. Note for everyone — KV cache warming will take ~5m after canary. If you see a short p99 blip during warm-up that's expected, but sustained p99 > 3s for >5m is a hard red flag.

deploy-bot: CI ✅ pipeline passed, canary image built (sha: c7a9f1). :party:

Maya: Canary window length? and what are the exact go/no-go metric thresholds we agree on (p95/p99/errors)?

Tim: Canary window = 10m. Go/no-go thresholds: sustained error rate > 1.5% for 5m OR p99 latency > 1.8s for 5m => trigger rollback. Also: CPU > 85% on any serving host for 3m => escalate and consider rollback. If automated evals show hallucination/regression spike on the eval prompt set (>5% drop in accuracy) => rollback.

Carla: Good. Also need embeddings smoke owner — Oliver?

Oliver: I'm finishing a quick embedding eval now, will post pass/fail before T-20. If I'm not available @Brian will step in.

Brian: Checklist I'll run at T+2m on canary: login, basic chat, long-context generation, embedding lookup, tracing headers present. I'll post bullet pass/fail.

Sam: Rollback command snippets (for ops reference):
```
# revert model router
kubectl set image deployment/model-router model-router=redwood/model-router:previous --namespace=prod
# scale back
kubectl scale deployment/model-server --replicas=3 --namespace=prod
# invalidate cache (admin endpoint)
curl -X POST $ADMIN_URL/cache/invalidate -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
```

Elise: Also note: DB migrations are not part of this deploy. No schema changes. If something requires DB rollback, escalate to @Carla + @Tim immediately — we will freeze traffic and follow DB rollback runbook.

Carla: Owners confirmed: rollback = Elise, smoke = Brian + Oliver, runtime = Sam, on-call = Tim. Final go/no-go post in this channel at T-15. If anyone cannot make T-15 ping me now. :thumbsup:

Tim: I'll be watching metrics and ready to flip the rollback switch. Will post the current baseline numbers at T-30.

Oliver: embedding eval looks good — top-k recall within expected bounds. Will re-run at T-5.

Carla: Thanks all — short, pragmatic runbook review done. We'll follow criteria above; if anyone sees something else we should add to criteria speak up now.
